summary.text: Derek Warriner is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 68, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A healthcare executive, he earned a bachelor's degree from Santa Clara University.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Warriner said he has been an executive in the healthcare industry for the last 15 years and is a father of daughters.

He said that before that he worked as a server, bartender, actor, reality TV show contestant, fundraiser and newspaper ad salesman, and that he has experienced life without health insurance and filing for unemployment.
He described the role of a public servant as doing the most good for the most people possible, regardless of who they are or what they believe.
